scripts.check:generated: git diff --exit-code HEAD -- docs data/generated && python -c "import subprocess, sys; output = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', 'docs', 'data/generated'], text=True); sys.stderr.write(output); sys.exit(bool(output))"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:shell
scripts.lint:js: eslint src tests tools/*.mjs playwright.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/*.test.js && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.verify: python -m compileall -q tools && npm run test:unit && python tools/verify_generated_outputs.py
